Sofia (CFO): Thanks everyone — quick follow-up from the AH finance segment. I'll capture a few clarifications here and answer live.

Raj (Eng): Quick Q — for Reserved/Dedicated commitments, what notice do we need to reduce capacity without penalties?

Sofia (CFO): FYI: standard committed capacity contracts have a 30d downgrade window. To avoid penalties you need to submit a cancellation request to finance 30 days before the billing cycle. If it's within the cycle there may be a pro-rated refund but not guaranteed.

Maya (Product): And for vendor contracts (3rd-party infra tools) — are we still treating >$50k as capex vs opex for approvals?

Sofia (CFO): Threshold: any vendor or contract >$50k annualized requires FP&A + Legal review and exec approval. Below that, Finance Ops (Ava) can approve via the procurement ticket.

Ava (Finance Ops): Adding: please open a procurement ticket with the template. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/servicedesk/procurement. Include `PO required: yes/no`, `GL code`, `owner`.

Raj (Eng): For open invoices, what's the month-end cutoff? We have some contractors billing late.

Sofia (CFO): Cutoff is EOB last business day of the month. Invoices submitted after cutoff get next-month accrual. If urgent, mark `PAY_NOW` in the ticket and CC Ava.

Liam (CEO): Quick ask — how many months of runway are we modeling w/ current committed spend vs soft pipeline?

Sofia (CFO): We're planning 14 months at current burn with conservative revenue assumptions. If we convert reserved capacity to on-demand that adds flexibility but increases unit costs.

Raj (Eng): Is there a temporary pcard limit increase process? Need to approve a $12k purchase for an urgent instance swap.

Ava (Finance Ops): Pcard increases up to $15k can be approved by Finance Ops + Manager. >$15k needs Director sign-off. For today, send an email to finance-ops@redwood.com with justification and cc your manager.

finance-bot: New procurement ticket created — PRO-4561 by Raj. Status: Needs finance review.

Maya (Product): Thanks — can we get a one-pager checklist with exact steps for teams to follow? Saves a lot of back-and-forth.

Sofia (CFO): Will do. I'll share a checklist in #docs by EOD tomorrow and tag the ticket template. Action: Sofia -> publish procurement & invoice runbook.

Raj (Eng): Appreciate it. @Ava I'll add the PO details now.

Ava (Finance Ops): Thanks — will review and respond within the same day if possible. :thumbsup: 

Sofia (CFO): Closing note: if you're planning multi-quarter reserved commitments, loop PM + Finance early so we can model impacts. Happy to take follow-ups here or via 1:1s.
